cases.refreshed: Bridge is great exercise for your brain! This Bridge program is designed for adults who are passionate about Bridge and are looking to enhance their game with regular practice and social interaction. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, making it an ideal setting to engage with fellow Bridge enthusiasts and to refine your strategies. Participants should be familiar with Bridge terminology and have experience in playing the hand as instructions or assistance will not be provided. Free. Seating is limited; registration required. This program is generously sponsored by the Friends of the Cambrian Library!

cases.refreshed: Drop in every Thursday afternoon for a new STEM adventure! Intended for ages 5-10, but all families are welcome. This week in celebration of Native American Heritage Month, we'll learn about John Herrington who is the first enrolled citizen of a Native American tribe to fly in space. Then, we'll learn about parachutes and make our own! Free. No registration is required.
